WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.COMPOSE_TRANSPORT_HELP: The inbox keeps the conversation history. Choose the sending provider separately; Meta requires an approved template for a new conversation.

META_INITIAL_MESSAGES.TITLE: Initial messages via Meta
META_INITIAL_MESSAGES.ENABLED: Prioritize Meta at the start of each attendance cycle
META_INITIAL_MESSAGES.HELP: When enabled, the first N eligible public outbound messages in each attendance cycle use Meta, regardless of the provider requested in the editor. The editor selection stays unchanged. Outside Meta's messaging window or for unsupported resources, the compatible selected transport is retained. After a send attempt, there is no duplicate send or automatic fallback to another provider.
META_INITIAL_MESSAGES.LIMIT_HELP: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1000. The default is 5; 0 disables this policy, even when checked.

REVIEWS.TITLE: Unified inbox technical exceptions
REVIEWS.HELP: This panel lists identification, sending and file exceptions for this link. It is not an approval queue for every message. Check the reason and conversation; identifiers are under Technical details, without exposing webhook contents.
REVIEWS.UNKNOWN_GUIDANCE: This panel has no specific guidance for this reason. Check the conversation and technical details with support before acting; do not assume the message failed or resend it automatically.
REVIEWS.NO_CONVERSATION: No conversation identified for this record.
REVIEWS.RECHECK_HELP: Requests another analysis of the available evidence. It does not guarantee a fix, identification or delivery confirmation; the item may remain pending.
REVIEWS.ACKNOWLEDGE_HELP: Records that someone reviewed this exception. It does not approve the message, fix the cause or confirm delivery.
REVIEWS.NO_RESEND: These actions never resend messages or merge contacts. Reviewing an item does not confirm delivery or complete processing.
REVIEWS.DISABLED_LINK: This link is disabled. Historical records remain available; evidence cannot be rechecked for an inactive link.
REVIEWS.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the review records. Try refreshing.
REVIEWS.ACTION_ERROR: Could not complete the action. Refresh and check the record before trying again.
REVIEWS.CHANGED: This record changed while you were reviewing it. The list was refreshed. Check the latest evidence and confirm again if needed.
REVIEWS.RECHECK_SUCCESS: Evidence recheck requested. No message was resent and no contact was merged. Refresh to check processing progress.
REVIEWS.ACKNOWLEDGE_SUCCESS: Marked as reviewed. This does not confirm delivery, complete processing or resend the message.
REVIEWS.DELIVERY_WARNING: The send has no conclusive confirmation. Do not resend automatically: the message may have been delivered. Check the provider and conversation before any intentional new send, which could duplicate it. This panel does not reset the sending state.
REVIEWS.READ_ONLY: Historical or read-only record. No action is currently available.
REVIEWS.CONFIRM_RECHECK: Recheck the available evidence? This does not resend the message or merge contacts. Unresolved conflicts may remain pending.
REVIEWS.CONFIRM_ACKNOWLEDGE: Mark this item as reviewed? This only records the administrative review; it does not confirm delivery or resolve the underlying issue.

REASONS.untrusted_mapping: Insufficient evidence to trust the identity mapping
REASONS.incompatible_messages: Messages are not compatible with safe reconciliation
REASONS.media_unavailable: Media file is not yet available
REASONS.attachment_scope: Attachment belongs to a different account scope
REASONS.media_mismatch: Media types or files are incompatible
REASONS.counterpart_pending: Waiting for the message from the other channel
REASONS.reservation_without_message: Reservation held without a canonical message; analysis is required and automatic reprocessing is not safe.

GUIDANCE.identity_pending: Evidence is still missing to identify the message safely. Check the conversation and recheck when new evidence is available; do not match messages by similar text.
GUIDANCE.outbound_response_pending: The provider response to the send does not yet provide sufficient evidence. Check the send with the provider and recheck later; do not resend automatically.
GUIDANCE.correlation_conflict: The channels reported conflicting message identity data, such as sender or direction. Check the conversation and technical details before deciding. This does not mean the content or file is incorrect; rechecking only examines the evidence again.
GUIDANCE.link_changed: The link or its activation cycle changed since this record. Check the link history with support before acting; rechecking does not restore the previous configuration.
GUIDANCE.identity_conflict: The evidence points to different identities. Check the provider messages with support; do not force a match or merge contacts through this panel.
GUIDANCE.processing_error: Processing encountered an error. Check technical details with support; after addressing the cause, recheck the evidence if the action is available.
GUIDANCE.correlated: The evidence has been matched. Check the current state and conversation; this alone does not confirm delivery or completion of all processing steps.
GUIDANCE.delivery_confirmation_uncertain: There is no conclusive confirmation of the send. The message may have been delivered: check the provider and conversation and do not resend automatically to avoid duplicates.
GUIDANCE.link_disabled: The inbox link is disabled. Check the configuration with its administrator; history remains available, but rechecking does not reactivate the link.
GUIDANCE.invalid_scope: The record does not match the expected link scope. Check the account and inboxes with support; do not try to match messages across accounts.
GUIDANCE.untrusted_mapping: The message mapping does not yet have trustworthy evidence. Check the source at both providers with support; rechecking alone does not make the mapping trustworthy.
GUIDANCE.incompatible_messages: The messages cannot be reconciled safely. Compare their type, source and files in the conversation; ask support to investigate without forcing a merge.
GUIDANCE.unsupported_media: Reconciliation does not support this media type. Check the original file in the conversation or provider and ask support for guidance; rechecking does not add format support.
GUIDANCE.media_unavailable: The required media file is not yet available. Check the file with the provider and recheck if it becomes accessible; do not automatically send another copy.
GUIDANCE.attachment_count: The attachment count prevents a safe match. Compare all files in the messages and ask support to investigate before reconciliation.
GUIDANCE.attachment_scope: The attachment is outside this account's expected scope. Check its source with support; do not copy or match files across accounts through this panel.
GUIDANCE.media_mismatch: The media types or files do not match. Compare the original attachments, including audio, before requesting another analysis; do not replace a file based on assumptions.
GUIDANCE.principal_unavailable: The primary message file needed for comparison is unavailable. This does not mean the channel is offline. Check the original attachment and recheck if the file becomes accessible.
GUIDANCE.counterpart_pending: Only one valid message identifier is available so far. The system automatically waits for the corresponding message from the other channel; this is a pending match, not conflicting evidence. Wait without resending the message or starting another file download. Waiting does not guarantee reconciliation or confirm delivery.
GUIDANCE.reservation_without_message: A technical reservation has no associated primary message. Ask support to investigate; automatic reprocessing is not safe. Marking reviewed only records the review.

WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.PIX_EXECUTOR_CONFIRM: The PIX key configured in inbox {inbox} will be sent via {provider}, independently of the editor preference. Confirm this payment request?
WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.PIX_CONFIRMATION_CHANGED: The PIX configuration, sending context or transport changed during confirmation. Nothing was sent. Review and confirm again.
WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.WILL_ROUTE: Will be sent via {provider}: unsupported on the selected provider. Your preference is unchanged; the server will revalidate before sending.
WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE: This feature is unsupported or its capabilities have not been verified. No automatic fallback is available.

SCHEDULE.HELP: This choice is saved with the schedule and does not change the editor. Permissions, the inbox link, supported features and Meta's messaging window will be checked again at sending time. Unsupported features may use the other provider; errors do not trigger automatic fallback.
SCHEDULE.LEGACY_HELP: Existing schedule: the original inbox provider was inferred. Saving confirms the provider shown here; it will not follow later changes to the default provider.
SCHEDULE.CONVERSATION_ERROR: Could not load the conversation. Select it again before scheduling.

WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.ROUTED: Sent via {provider}: the selected provider does not support this operation. Your preference has not changed.
WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.TITLE: Unified inbox / Coexistence
WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.HELP: Link Meta and ViperConnect for the same business number. Preview verifies conflicts; existing history and private notes are preserved. Web is an independent destination.
WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.NO_CANDIDATES_HELP: An inbox from the other provider (Meta or ViperConnect) is required in the same account with the same business number. You must have access to it, and it must not be actively linked to another inbox. Create or check the partner inbox and refresh this page.
WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.PRIMARY_HELP: The primary inbox owns conversations, history and assignments, independently of the default sending provider.
WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.LOCKED: The partner and primary inbox cannot be changed after activation. Reconciliation requires a separate reviewed procedure.
WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.NO_CONFLICTS: No conflicts reported by the preview.
WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.CONFIRM: I reviewed the preview and confirm this change. Disabling or removing the link preserves messages and does not undo prior deliveries.
WHATSAPP_UNIFIED.REPLY_UNAVAILABLE: This provider cannot reply now. Choose another provider explicitly or use an approved template where available.
